title: hieracium lachenalii subsp. pseudoramosum
intro: Hieracium lachenalii subsp. pseudoramosum, commonly known as Hawkweed, is a plant species belonging to the sunflower family (Asteraceae). It is traditionally used in herbal medicine to support digestion and liver health, thanks to its reported health benefits, such as alleviating digestive issues and promoting liver function. The therapeutic actions of Hawkweed include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids. These bioactive compounds contribute to the plant's therapeutic effects, although more research is needed to fully understand its medicinal properties.
